data.gender_notes: Elwira is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old Slavic name Elvira, derived from elo (elf) and vira (rule, warrior). The name Elwira evokes images of mythical creatures and strength in Slavic folklore. The name Elwira carries the meaning “Elf-rule, Elf-warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Elwira usually hope their child will grow to embody elf-rule, elf-warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine protection and guidance for elves and humans alike.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elwira total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.name: Ελβίρα
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Ελβίρα είναι όνομα γερμανικής προέλευσης που σημαίνει 'Θεός είναι το φως μου'. Το όνομα αυτό προέρχεται από τη σύνθεση των λέξεων Θεός και φως, εκφράζοντας τη στενή σχέση με το Θεό και την καθοδήγησή Του και τη φωτεινότητά Του στη ζωή του φορέα του ονόματος.

in_latin.name: Elwira
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Elwira origine Germanico ortum est, quod significat 'Deus est lux mea'. Hoc nomen ex compositione vocum Deus et lux constat, significans arctam conjunctionem cum Deo et illuminationem et ductum eius in vita eius qui hoc nomen gerit.

in_english.name: Elwira
in_english.long_meaning: Elwira is a Christian name of Germanic origin, meaning 'God is my light'. Derived from the combination of 'God' and 'light', it signifies a close relationship with God and His guidance and brightness in the life of the bearer. Historically, the name reflects the biblical theme of God as the light of His people, as seen in Psalm 27:1, 'The Lord is my light and my salvation.' Elwira embodies spiritual meaning, personality traits of faith, hope, and illumination, and is used across various Christian cultures.

data.cultural_impact: Elwira harkens back to the rich cultural traditions of Eastern European folklore, particularly in the Slavic region. With its roots in the Old Slavic name Elvira, meaning 'elf-ruler' or 'elf-warrior,' this name carries the magical and mystical energy of the ancient belief systems that once thrived in this area. Elwira might also be reminiscent of prominent medieval Slavic saints with similar names, further enhancing the sense of spiritual connection to this culture.
data.spiritual_significance: Elwira's spiritual significance is rooted in the inherent power of the name itself. Its derivation from Old Slavic elements symbolizes a union between the ethereal realms of elves and the earthly realm of rule or dominion. This spiritual meaning suggests a connection to the strength and resourcefulness of an elf, embodying grace, intelligence, and profound resilience. For those who bear the name Elwira, it can serve as a constant reminder of the divine power within them to face challenges and rise above them with wisdom and determination. Additionally, it can evoke memories of the powerful and spiritual connection between humans and nature that is deeply rooted in Slavic folklore.
